<description>
Currently there is no test coverage for oversized CompactSize. This is fine, because a vector this large will already be rejected earlier by the P2P transport payload size check.

However, it would be good to still add test coverage:

* Removing the check would pass all tests.
* There is some accidental non-deterministic coverage through tx-deser "fuzzing", which hurts coverage reports, see https://github.com/corecheck/corecheck/pull/219#discussion_r4554170963.
* Having explicit end-to-end P2P coverage for such corrupt messages seems fine.
</description>

[2026-11-16] c:6924155921 comment by m3dwards (member):
If this is useful to anyone, here a script that reproduces the non-determinism in coverage. With this PR applied it is fixed.

Script

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Coverage check for the src/serialize.h "ReadCompactSize(): size too large" guard.
# Builds with LLVM coverage, then runs the unit suite's serialisation cases and one
# functional test per run, and reports the guard's execution count for each run.
# Run from the bitcoin checkout root. Needs clang, cmake, python3, llvm-profdata and
# llvm-cov on PATH. Usage: ./guard-flip.sh [runs]      (default 8)
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
RUNS=${1:-8}

echo 'Building bitcoin with coverage'

cmake -B build -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
  -DAPPEND_CFLAGS="-fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping" \
  -DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS="-fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping" \
  -DAPPEND_LDFLAGS="-fprofile-instr-generate" \
  -DBUILD_GUI=OFF -DBUILD_BENCH=OFF -DBUILD_FUZZ_BINARY=OFF >/dev/null
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)" --target bitcoind bitcoin-cli test_bitcoin >/dev/null

L=$(grep -n 'ReadCompactSize(): size too large' src/serialize.h | cut -d: -f1)
echo "guard line: src/serialize.h:$L"
counts=()
for i in $(seq "$RUNS"); do
  d=$(mktemp -d)
  LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=$d/u_%m_%p.profraw ./build/bin/test_bitcoin --run_test=serialize_tests >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=$d/f_%m_%p.profraw TMPDIR=/tmp \
    python3 build/test/functional/test_runner.py wallet_create_tx.py --randomseed=1234 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  llvm-profdata merge -o "$d/p.profdata" "$d"/*.profraw 2>/dev/null
  llvm-cov export --format=lcov --object=build/bin/bitcoind --object=build/bin/test_bitcoin \
    --instr-profile="$d/p.profdata" > "$d/info" 2>"$d/err" || true
  c=$(awk -F'[:,]' -v l="$L" '/^SF:.*serialize\.h$/ {s=1} s && $1=="DA" && $2==l {print $3; exit}' "$d/info")
  [ -n "$c" ] || { echo "run $i: no DA record for line $L, see $d/err" >&2; exit 2; }
  counts+=("$c")
  echo "run $i: $c"
  rm -rf "$d"
done
echo "counts: ${counts[*]}"
if printf '%s\n' "${counts[@]}" | grep -qx 0; then
  echo "FLIPS: the guard was left uncovered on at least one run"
else
  echo "NO FLIPS: the guard was covered on every run"
fi

```
